statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying etiology of these collapse events
CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) was ordered
The service is intended to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service is intended to determine whether an arrhythmia explains the syncope
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
